name: USD Coin

expectedCapabilities.justification: Mints and burns against dollar reserves as users deposit and redeem.
expectedCapabilities.constrainedBy: Reserve attestations and US regulatory supervision

expectedCapabilities.justification: Legally required. US permitted stablecoin issuers must retain the ability to freeze and seize on lawful order. Circle has exercised this in practice.

evidence.detail: Legacy Token program. decimals 6. mintAuthority ACTIVE and freezeAuthority ACTIVE, both verified directly against Solana mainnet RPC.
Circle publishes USDC reserve attestations and its freeze policy.

caveats: Being listed here does not mean the token cannot lose value or depeg.
It means the named capabilities are structurally expected, not that the issuer is beyond criticism.
An expected capability is still a capability. The issuer can use it.
This is the canonical case for why blanket rules fail. Both authorities are live, and this is the lowest structural risk token in the registry.
